entries.name: Fly.io Machines
entries.description: Provision and manage Fly.io machines (VMs) via x402.

usage.callShape: POST https://httpay.xyz/api/gateway/flyio/{path}/* — the {path} segment must be a real Fly.io Machines API route (e.g. v1/apps/{app_name}/machines)
usage.outputShape: unknown (untested — Fly.io Machines API JSON proxied through httpay gateway)
quirks: URL is a wildcard-path gateway proxy: %7B*path%7D decodes to {*path}, a placeholder you MUST replace with a real Fly.io Machines API path before calling
Requires a concrete Fly.io app name and sub-route (e.g. /v1/apps/<app>/machines) — not derivable from the registry spec
httpay gateway proxy: an unpaid pre-flight returns 402 (looks payable) but that does NOT mean an arbitrary/unfilled path will work; paying an unresolved path risks a charge-then-404
inputSchema is only {type:http,method:GET,discoverable:true} — no body schema, no instructions, no paymentAccepts in the registry surface
usage.guide: This endpoint is an httpay x402 gateway proxy to the Fly.io Machines API. The CALL URL contains a wildcard placeholder {*path} that an agent MUST replace with a concrete Fly.io Machines API route before calling — for example POST .../api/gateway/flyio/v1/apps/<your-app>/machines with a machine-config JSON body. Provisioning/managing VMs is an outward, billable, stateful action, so it requires a target app name and explicit user approval. It was NOT pay-tested here because the path placeholder is unresolvable from the spec and paying a blank/wrong path would lose money to a 404.

entries.name: VpsAgent
entries.description: VpsAgent — on-demand VPS catalog and provisioning.

usage.outputShape: Intended (per outputSchema, never reached): array of {sku, track, price_usdc, duration_minutes, spec_floor:{vcpu,memory_mb}, available, description}
quirks: Payment FAILS at the facilitator: endpoint's 402 paymentRequirements use network 'base' (legacy x402 v1 string) which the CDP facilitator rejects with 'payment_invalid' / invalid_request — network must be a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453.
Pre-flight 402 looks payable (probe.payable=true) but the actual pay attempt cannot settle. No USDC was spent (paid:false, costUsd:0).
Do NOT retry — the malformed paymentRequirements are server-side; retries cannot succeed until the provider fixes the network field.
usage.guide: This endpoint is currently uncallable. GET https://vpsagent.fly.dev/catalog returns a 402 with x402 paymentRequirements whose network is the legacy string 'base' instead of a CAIP-2 id (eip155:8453), so the CDP facilitator rejects the payment with error 'payment_invalid' and the call cannot be settled. No money is lost, but no catalog data is returned. Treat as broken until the provider fixes the network field.

entries.name: Spraay Compute Batch
entries.description: Spraay — batch compute jobs via x402.

usage.callShape: POST https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/compute/batch with JSON body {jobs:[{type,...}]} where type is one of text-inference, image-generation, video-generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, embeddings
quirks: Charge-then-fail: gateway returns HTTP 200 with valid batch accounting (batch_id, results[], cost breakdown) but the actual job FAILS at the upstream 'Chutes' inference backend, which returns a 404 HTML page instead of a result. You pay $0.05/call and get no usable output.

Empty inputSchema in registry. The job 'type' field is REQUIRED; omitting it 400s with hint listing valid types: text-inference, image-generation, video-generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, embeddings.

text-inference job failed even with valid {type, messages} shape; likely also needs a 'model' field, but the upstream backend route is itself dead (404), so supplying a model would not have produced a working result.
Charged twice during QA ($0.10 total): first $0.05 on the type-missing 400, second $0.05 on the 200-but-job-failed call. Payment is taken before the job outcome is known.
No txHash returned by the payment layer (confirmed:false).
usage.guide: Do not rely on this endpoint: it charges but does not produce results.
